technology_name: Weather Resistant Coir for Construction Applications
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: High maintenance and replacement requirements of conventional coir materials used in erosion control and construction
description: This weather-resistant coir material is intended for use in construction and erosion-control applications. It provides improved strength and durability while reducing the need for frequent replacement. The treatment process is designed to be cost-effective compared with conventional geotextile treatment methods.
applications:
Civil construction and infrastructure development companies
Erosion control and slope stabilization projects
Road, railway, and riverbank protection works
Coir geotextile manufacturers and eco-material producers
Government agencies and environmental restoration programs
